key_notes: Key 1 (t=1.96s): Initial archival pose of brain; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=3.08s): Mid-sequence articulation of brain; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=4.32s): Peak dynamic extension of brain over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=5.56s): Follow-through and settle of brain with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of brain (1.96s..5.56s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
